brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A curled, part-baked and part-pan-fired green tea from Fu'an, Fujian, made from the Fuyun 7 clone.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
history: It was developed by a research institute of the Fujian Academy of Agricultural Sciences and sells in Jiangsu, Shanghai, Shandong and Beijing. Little more is documented about it.
processing: Fixed, rolled, given a first firing, shaped by pan or cloth rolling, spread, then fully fired.
harvest_season: Around the spring equinox, one bud with one just-opening leaf.
taste_profile: Fresh, brisk and sweetly mellow with a strong chestnut aroma.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
